name: Gekka Chou no Yakata
source:
Main character is a detective. Head of Himemiya family is murdered, and investigation shows that one of the three daughters is the culprit. The only clue that he finds is that killer must have a butterfly bruise somewhere. Detective offers girls to play strip mahjong to have a possibility to explore their bodies.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名侦探。姬宫家家主遭到谋杀，调查显示凶手是三个女儿中的一个。他找到的唯一线索是，凶手身上某处一定有蝴蝶形瘀伤。为了获得检查女孩身体的机会，侦探提出与她们玩脱衣麻将。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-august-2002-ever17-out-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
